safety_verdicts.content: Patient has had asthma since childhood.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated only states a history of asthma, not that it has been present since childhood (section 012 lacks ‘since childhood’).
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting that asthma has been present since childhood removes a useful severity/chronicity detail and may slightly affect risk stratification (e.g., differentiating long-standing asthma from adult-onset or alternative cardiopulmonary causes). In this encounter it is unlikely to change immediate management of a mild exacerbation but can reduce longitudinal clinical accuracy.

safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold states patient suffers from eczema; generated lists eczema treatments and family eczema but does not clearly state patient has eczema.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Failure to clearly document the patient’s eczema can obscure an atopic history and may affect counseling and future management (e.g., steroid burden across conditions, trigger avoidance, or medication reconciliation for dermatologic treatments). It is unlikely to cause direct harm in the acute shortness-of-breath presentation but represents clinically relevant comorbidity loss.
